 "content": "def _bbox(cells):
    return min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The output is the area below the separator, with the matching colored
    # object copied next to the lower reference according to the arrow.
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[sep + 1:]]

    target = [(r - sep - 1, c) for r in range(sep + 1, h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    other_color = next(color for color in set(v for row in grid[:sep] for v in row)
                       if color not in (0, 1, 2, 5))
    other = [(r, c) for r in range(sep) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == other_color]
    arrow = [(r, c) for r in range(sep) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]

    tr0, tc0, tr1, tc1 = _bbox(target)
    ar0, ac0, ar1, ac1 = _bbox(arrow)
    # Broad end at the top denotes an upward arrow; broad end at bottom denotes down.
    up = sum(grid[ar0][c] == 2 for c in range(ac0, ac1 + 1)) > sum(grid[ar1][c] == 2 for c in range(ac0, ac1 + 1))
    or0, oc0, or1, oc1 = _bbox(other)
    shape = [(r - or0, c - oc0) for r, c in other]
    sh, sw = or1 - or0 + 1, oc1 - oc0 + 1

    if up:
        dest_r = tr1 + 1
    else:
        dest_r = tr0 - sh
    dest_c = tc0
    for dr, dc in shape:
        rr, cc = dest_r + dr, dest_c + dc
        if 0 <= rr < len(out) and 0 <= cc < w:
            out[rr][cc] = other_color
    return out
"
}
